name: Fresh and Tart Chelada (Mexican Lime and Beer Cocktail)

ingredients.name: lime juice, half a juiced lime reserved for the rim

instructions.primary_message: Pour kosher or sea salt into a small, shallow dish in an even layer. Rub a pint or pilsner glass's rim with the cut side of the reserved juiced lime half, then dip glass into the dish to create a salt rim.

Set glass right side up and fill with lime juice. Add a pinch or two of salt, fill glass with ice, and top with beer. Stir gently if you want to mix it up a bit. Serve with remaining beer, topping up as you drink.

description: A chelada is a more basic version of the michelada, the chili-spiked Mexican beer cocktail—just fresh lime juice, beer, and a little salt, with none of its cousin's spicy intensity.
notes:
Optional substitutions: Kosher salt → sea salt

Notes: If you want a less tart version of the drink, experiment with using less lime juice—1 or 43 g can work, too.
author: Daniel Gritzer
